dialogue.epistemic_note: the epistemic status is set by the fact the proposition is grounded in, never by the speaker's intent: DIRECT_OBSERVATION / EXPERIENCED are first-hand, SECOND_HAND / HEARSAY are told, and a told fact can never be rendered as "I saw" (dialogue/grounding.py epistemic_of)

after_the_run.note: re-read from session.world.cognition.memories after the run; a citation no longer held was consolidated away between being spoken and the end of the day (MemoryStore.consolidate runs every 600 s of game time), which is memory working, not a grounding failure
